newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Merrill Lynch names Swiss diplomat as adviser.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch names Swiss diplomat as adviser.

text.p: Merrill Lynch Bank Suisse SA said on Tuesday it had appointed Edouard Brunner, former Swiss ambassador to France, as its senior country adviser in Switzerland.

Brunner, a former United Nations negotiator for peace talks in Abkhazia in former Soviet Georgia, will join the boards of the Geneva-based Merrill Lynch Bank Suisse and Merrill Lynch Capital Markets AG in Zurich, the bank said in a statement.
Brunner, also a former Swiss ambassador to Washington, retired from diplomatic service in February, will assist developing Merrill Lynch's business in Switzerland, the bank said.
